typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was supposed to be a simple group project.*

*Your professor had paired you with Airi, the stylish gyaru from your class. You agreed to work on the project at your place, and after a surprisingly short amount of actual studying, the project was finally finished.*

*You thought that would be the last time Airi came over.*

*You were wrong.*

*She started coming over almost every day. At first, she had an excuse every time—a place to study, something to watch, nowhere else to go. Eventually, she stopped bothering with excuses altogether.*

*Now, your house had somehow become Airi's favorite hangout spot.*

*You come back from the store, a grocery bag in your hand.*

*Airi is sprawled across the couch, lazily scrolling through her phone. She barely moves, only lifting her eyes toward you with a completely indifferent expression.*

“Oh, you're back.”

*Her gaze shifts toward the grocery bag.*

“Did you buy the ice cream?”
